BindAlias.title: Attach Alias
BindAlias.summary: Attach an alias to a device.

BindPhone.title: Attach Phone Number
BindPhone.summary: Attaches a device to a phone number.

BindTag.title: Attach Tags
BindTag.summary: Binds tags to specified device targets. Tag bindings take effect within 10 minutes.

CancelPush.title: Cancel Scheduled Push Task
CancelPush.summary: Cancels a scheduled push task that has not yet been executed.

CheckCertificate.title: Query certificate status
CheckCertificate.summary: Checks the expiration time and current status of the iOS certificate for a specified app.

CheckDevices.title: Batch check device validity
CheckDevices.summary: Validate a specified group of devices.

CompleteContinuouslyPush.title: Complete a Continuous Push Task
CompleteContinuouslyPush.summary: Manually ends a continuous push task.

ContinuouslyPush.title: ContinuouslyPush
ContinuouslyPush.summary: Executes a predefined continuous push task.

ListSummaryApps.title: Query the list of applications created by the user
ListSummaryApps.summary: Retrieve the list of all applications associated with your Alibaba Cloud account.

ListTags.title: Obtain the tag list
ListTags.summary: Queries the tags of an app. A maximum of 100 records are returned.

MassPush.title: MassPush
MassPush.summary: Push different messages/notifications to different devices in batch.

MassPushV2.title: Batch push
MassPushV2.summary: Pushes notifications in batch by using the advanced push API V2.

Push.title: Advanced Push
Push.summary: Advanced Push API that pushes notifications or messages to different device endpoints. This API provides rich push customization parameters to implement push behavior in different scenarios.

PushMessageToAndroid.title: Push Message to Android Devices
PushMessageToAndroid.summary: Sends a message to an Android device through the Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push proprietary channel. After the app on the device receives the message, it must handle subsequent actions, such as implementing business logic or displaying a local notification.

PushMessageToiOS.title: Push Message to iOS Devices
PushMessageToiOS.summary: Pushes messages to iOS devices. These messages are delivered through the proprietary channel of Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push. After the app on a device receives a message, it must handle subsequent actions, such as implementing business behaviors or creating local notifications.

PushNoticeToAndroid.title: Push Notification to Android Devices
PushNoticeToAndroid.summary: Sends a notification to Android devices. The notification appears directly in the device’s notification tray and may be delivered through Alibaba Cloud’s proprietary channel or the device manufacturer’s channel, depending on the scenario.

PushNoticeToiOS.title: Push Notification to iOS Devices
PushNoticeToiOS.summary: Send a notification to iOS devices. The notification uses Apple’s APNs channel and appears directly in the device notification center.

PushV2.title: Advanced push
PushV2.summary: Sends a push notification by using the advanced push API V2.

QueryAliases.title: Query alias
QueryAliases.summary: Query the list of aliases attached to a specified device.

QueryDeviceInfo.title: Query device details
QueryDeviceInfo.summary: Query details of a specified device.

QueryDeviceStat.title: New and Retained Devices
QueryDeviceStat.summary: Queries device statistics by application dimension.

QueryDevicesByAccount.title: Query device list by account
QueryDevicesByAccount.summary: Retrieve the list of devices associated with an account using the account name.

QueryDevicesByAlias.title: Query device list by alias
QueryDevicesByAlias.summary: Query the list of devices by alias.

QueryPushRecords.title: Query Alert Delivery Records
QueryPushRecords.summary: You can query push records with pagination and basic filtering.

QueryPushStatByApp.title: App dimension push statistics
QueryPushStatByApp.summary: Query push statistics for an app.

QueryPushStatByMsg.title: Job Dimension Push Statistics
QueryPushStatByMsg.summary: Queries push statistics for a message.

QueryTags.title: Query Tag List
QueryTags.summary: Queries tags for a specified object, such as a device, account, or alias.

QueryUniqueDeviceStat.title: Deduplicated Device Statistics
QueryUniqueDeviceStat.summary: Obtain deduplicated device statistics for an app.

RemoveTag.title: Remove Tags
RemoveTag.summary: Removes a tag from an app.

UnbindAlias.title: Detach Alias
UnbindAlias.summary: Unbinds an alias. The change takes effect immediately.

UnbindPhone.title: Detach Phone Number
UnbindPhone.summary: Unbind the mobile phone number from a specified device.

UnbindTag.title: Detach Tag
UnbindTag.summary: Unbinds one or more tags from a specified target.
